name: autonomous-operator
description: Prepare bounded mission prompts and coordinate scoped work with Astra, Sol, Luna, and optional GPT-6 Pro Web.

interface.longDescription: Create a scoped mission prompt with outcomes, worker limits, review routing, GPT-6 Pro Web allowance, and action authority. The form does not start agents or grant authority by itself.
defaultPrompt: Open the local Autonomous Operator mission form.
Use $autonomous-operator to execute my scoped mission.
Use $autonomous-operator to continue my saved mission from its current evidence.
